svg.title: The seven stages of lab 301.1E

text.font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace
Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven stages. Each answers one question and hands something to the next.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You lead the first three, the tools check the next three, and you decide at the end. Nobody builds anything today.
